releaseNotes: A gateway on your own network is finally reachable. The app always accepted http for localhost while the platform refused every cleartext request, and a private address was refused by both - so a router running on your own machine failed with a message that blamed the model. Cleartext is now permitted for loopback and for this machine's address on the home network only; everything on the public internet still requires https. This is what lets the phone use the router running on the PC.
